svg.title: The tables that let you answer why it said that
svg.desc: A data model for a retrieval system in which a source document is split into passages, each passage is stored once as a vector, and a question is joined to the passages it matched through a retrieval record, so that every answer carries citations pinning it to an exact character range inside a specific passage.
